description: This Java source file defines the EchoServer class, which implements an HTTP server with WebSocket support, using Netty. It manages server startup, shutdown, request handling, and response configuration within the mockserver project.

classes.name: EchoServer
classes.description: Main class implementing a mock HTTP/WebSocket server with start/stop capabilities, request handling, and response management.

classes.name: EchoServer.NextResponse
classes.description: Inner class representing a queue of HTTP responses to be served.

classes.name: EchoServer.LastRequest
classes.description: Inner class holding the last received HTTP request, using an atomic reference to a CompletableFuture.

methods.name: EchoServer
methods.description: Constructs and starts the server, configuring Netty bootstrap and event loops.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the scheduler and Netty event loop groups gracefully.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server by invoking stop.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on, with timeout handling.

methods.name: mockServerEventLog
methods.description: Returns the mock server event log instance.

methods.name: withNextResponse
methods.description: Sets the next HTTP responses to be served; used mainly for testing.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears queued responses and resets last request; used mainly for testing.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the last received HTTP request, with timeout and exception handling.

methods.name: getRegisteredClients
methods.description: Returns the list of registered WebSocket clients.

methods.name: getWebsocketChannels
methods.description: Returns the list of WebSocket channels.

methods.name: getTextWebSocketFrames
methods.description: Returns the list of WebSocket text frames.
